comment: Credentials come from env CYPRESS_TEST_USER_EMAIL / CYPRESS_TEST_USER_PASSWORD and optional CYPRESS_TEST_ADMIN_EMAIL / CYPRESS_TEST_ADMIN_PASSWORD, CYPRESS_TEST_MEMBER_EMAIL / CYPRESS_TEST_MEMBER_PASSWORD. Use same password for all if single seed user.

roles.owner: owner or admin; can see billing and audit
roles.member: member; cannot see billing or audit
